provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 400 LIVE OAK RD, EARLY, TX, 76802

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver present today who previously had a eligible background check did not have a current background check at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Two caregivers present today, counted in ratio and alone with children did not have current frist aid/CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation was lacking an annual fire inspection. This was corrected at inspection when the fire marshall came and completed a new inspection, bringing the operation back into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: The Director and one caregiver did not have current CPR/First aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: 2 classrooms had liquid plug-ins plugged into the walls that were in access to children in care. a cabinet in the main are of the center that was in access to children in care and unlocked contained fish food and fish tank water treatment. Furthermore, a cabinet in the eating area was accessible to children in care contained cleaning supplies. This was corrected at inspection when the plug-ins were removed and the locks were placed on the cabinets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics: Upon review of staff files 5 staff files were lacking training in required topics for the health and safety measures.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics (26 TAC §746.1309(f))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver in the two and 3 year old classroom was  present at the operation before receiving notice from the CBCU regarding the their eligibility. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver left the premises.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: 3 infants in the infant room were not buckled into their highchairs during meal service. This was corrected at inspection when the children were buckled in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A 5 month old infant was in the crib inside of a bouncer. Another 5 month old was observed sleeping in their crib with a blanket. This was corrected at inspection when the bouncer was placed on the floor and the blanket was removed from the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: 1 caregiver that has been employed longer than 90 days did not have CPR certifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion: Operational policies and procedures were missing suspension and expulsion, infant safe sleep, applying insect repellent/sunscreen, breastfeeding procedures, and gang-free zone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion (26 TAC §746.501(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Six personnel files were audited during the inspection.  Various items were missing from the files such as the date of hire, proof of high school diploma/GED, eligible background check, and a copy of photo I.D./driver's license.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: CPR has not yet been completed for the two staff who had expired certifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Two staff had expired CPR and first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Two staff had the health and safety trainings and sids/sbs training that expired at the end of August.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Out of four records reviewed, two children did not have current health statements and vision and hearing screenings.
Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: A fire drill and severe weather and lock down drills were not conducted the month of August.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Two new hires did not have cleared eligibility letters prior to being put in a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
